# Esther Inspired

Esther Inspired styles both Obsidian and Typora with a warm palette of blue structure, yellow emphasis and subtle red accents, holding typography consistent across reading and preview. The recorded description lists automatic light and dark switching in Obsidian, two Typora themes named Paper and Midnight, full element styling, and no network requests.

![Esther Inspired screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lisitan/esther-obsidian-typora-themes/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue

    name:   "Esther Inspired"
    author: "lisitan"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]

Include Obsidian auto light/dark, two Typora themes (Paper, Midnight), full element styling, and no network requests."
